body: Owner: no extra stable-column test for plugin tables. Apps query plugin tables through each plugin's exported sqlb.Col handles; a rename keeps working and a removal is a compile error on upgrade. Raw SQL against auth tables is the app's own risk. Docs: add one paragraph to docs/concepts/databases.md Step 6 saying so.
title: Stable columns: the exported sqlb column handles are the contract (owner 2026-10-10)
